name: Ask
description: 向用户提选择题并结束本轮。Ask the user multiple-choice questions and end the turn.

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: 向用户提 1 到 4 道选择题并结束本轮。Ask 1-4 multiple-choice questions, then end this turn. Pass { questions: [{ question, header (≤12 characters), multiSelect, options: [{ label, description }] }] }. Each question needs 2-4 options. The UI adds an Other free-text choice; do not add an Other option yourself. Returns immediately and ends the turn. Do not continue or poll.

questions.description: 1 to 4 questions. The UI adds Other; do not include it.
